status: failed hypothesis; retained artifacts are stale and cannot reproduce the recorded count
result: The shipped model000.bin is a stale artifact: its 25-row weight table populates only 17 taps and stores a reversed kernel, while its expected000.i8 was generated from a 25-tap reference. Re-running it on the board (16 inferences captured) gives an output that is uncorrelated with both its own expected bytes (correlation 0.006) and the float ONNX model (0.0017), so the historical 98/675 off-by-one figure cannot be reproduced from these files. The board run itself is clean (runs=16 rc=0).
conclusion: K5 stays rejected. To revisit it, the emitter must pack all 25 taps in the vendor's 32-byte lane layout with per-channel weight zero points and reuse the vendor register set; the current depthwise-transpose path only emits K2/K3 and reuses K3 defaults.

The vendor's per-lane zero points are (2, 1, -3) for the captured fixture, i.e. asymmetric per-channel weight quantization, unlike the symmetric weights the retained experiment used.
